anomalies.observed: Net USBC_D_N contains both USB-C VBUS pins (J3.A4/A9/B4/B9) and USB-C D- pins (J3.A7/B7), and also U25 pin5 (VBUS) and pin4 (I/O2).
anomalies.expected: VBUS pins should be on a separate VBUS net; D- pins and U25 I/O2 should be on USBC_D_N, isolated from VBUS.
anomalies.impact: Short between USB VBUS and USB D-, preventing USB communication and potentially damaging USB host/device.

anomalies.observed: Both GND1 (logic side) and GND2 (isolated side) of isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 are connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: GND1 should connect to logic ground; GND2 should connect to an isolated ground separate from logic GND to maintain galvanic isolation.
anomalies.impact: Defeats galvanic isolation of CAN buses, allowing ground loops and common-mode voltages to pass, potentially damaging equipment and violating the intended isolated CAN design.

anomalies.expected: The value, description, and MPN should agree; for a bleeder across VOUTP/VOUTN, 24k is appropriate, so the MPN/description should be a 24k part.
